reviews.author: Stephanie Frey
reviews.text: Dillon with Farmers made our switch incredibly seamless from start to finish. His customer service was outstanding—he was responsive, easy to communicate with, and took the time to answer all of our questions thoroughly. The whole process felt simple and stress-free, which we really appreciated. Highly recommend if you’re looking for great service and a smooth experience!

reviews.author: Michelle Lewis
reviews.text: Ashley was very helpful in putting together a quote for us and reviewing it thoroughly. She responded to any questions in a timely manner and was more than willing to help. We ended up switching because Farmers was able to save us some money per year.

reviews.author: Brandon Bridges
reviews.text: Ashley has been great! She got me lower rates on home and auto saving hundreds per month. She has been easy to work with and very responsive, answering all my questions along the way. I’ll definitely be back in a year or two to review policies with her again and keep the savings rolling.

reviews.author: Crystal Farley
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Bret, Pete and the entire office staff at Ballentine Insurance. We have been long time customers for both our personal and commercial needs. They are always ready and willing to answer questions and VERY prompt with responses and requests. If you are looking for a great, reputable insurance company I highly recommend you give Ballentine Insurance the opportunity!
reviews.response: Thank you for sharing your experience with our agency Crystal! We’re thrilled to hear that Pete and I were able to assist you and make the process smooth & easy. Our goal is always to provide the best service and find the right coverage for our clients. If you ever need anything in the future, don’t hesitate to reach out. We truly appreciate your trust in us!

reviews.author: Krista Hurd
reviews.text: One of our vehicles was recently totaled, and during the initial stages of working with the insurance company, we encountered several challenges related to communication and delays. At that point, we brought Bret in to assist with the process, and the difference was immediate. Bret quickly stepped in, assessed the situation, and got the ball rolling without hesitation. His professionalism, combined with a clear and direct communication style, helped cut through the roadblocks and reach the appropriate parties needed to move the process forward. Bret was proactive, persistent, and incredibly thorough, staying on top of every detail until the matter was fully resolved. Throughout the entire process, he kept us informed, was highly responsive to questions, and made what could have been a stressful situation feel manageable and well-handled. Bret was truly a pleasure to work with, and his dedication and follow-through gave us great confidence during a challenging time. We will absolutely continue working with Bret moving forward and would highly recommend him to anyone in need of knowledgeable, reliable, and effective support.

reviews.author: Max M
reviews.text: Pete has helped my family for years and we love him! Second generation with him.

reviews.author: Helene
reviews.text: Balentine’s office of Farmers insurance has employees who take care of you like they’re your neighbor - if you’re lucky enough to live in a neighborhood where your neighbors still want to get to know each other. They return your phone call and ask how they can help, listen and then take action. I’d like to specifically point out, Pete, who goes out of his way to follow through with whatever help you may need, as I did today. I was a customer at this specific office for years before I moved away to Texas. But I still have a policy with them. And even though I’m not local, when I call, they’re quick to answer the phone, listen and assist. I highly recommend them.
reviews.response: Thank you so much, Helene! We really appreciate your thoughtful words and continued loyalty — even from Texas! It means a lot that you still trust our office after all these years. Pete and the team take pride in treating every customer like a true neighbor, whether you’re right here in Kansas City or miles away. We’re grateful for your recommendation and for being part of the BIG family!

reviews.author: Jane Sommers
reviews.text: Pete Carrol is by far the best agent we have ever used. He’s been taking care of our family’s auto/home insurance needs for as long as he’s been with Farmer’s. He responds immediately to every email, and voice mail. He always has an answer to all our questions and if he doesn’t, he’s honest and says he’ll get us an answer, and ALWAYS keeps us updated in the process. And on top of that always friendly and willing to go the extra mile for us. We appreciate Pete!
reviews.response: Thank you so much, Jane! We couldn’t agree more Pete truly goes above and beyond for our customers, and we’re lucky to have him on the BIG Team. We appreciate your family’s loyalty and the trust you’ve placed in us over the years. Thanks for sharing your experience!

reviews.author: Cynthia Jackman
reviews.text: The first time contacting this agency I just basically had questions and an interest in making him my agent. Bret and Pete both went above and beyond for me and they genuinely were concerned about finding me exactly what I needed. Adding the policy was a smooth and easy transition I highly recommend them for your auto insurance!
reviews.response: Thank you for sharing your experience with our agency Cynthia! We’re thrilled to hear that Pete and I were able to assist you and make the process smooth & easy. Our goal is always to provide the best service and find the right coverage for our clients. If you ever need anything in the future, don’t hesitate to reach out. We truly appreciate your trust in us!

reviews.author: Duncan Hill
reviews.text: Spectacular service! Went above and beyond to ensure I had the best rate. Rates were cheaper for the first week with one insurer, but cheaper in perpetuity after the first week with Farmers. They took care of it all for me, I didn’t have to worry about a thing. 10/10 would recommend!
reviews.response: Thanks Duncan! We like to think outside the box here and appreciate customers like you willing to go there with us.

reviews.author: Marissa Young
reviews.text: We can’t say enough good things about Bret and Pete! They have the lowest rates, are quick to respond to emails, and are very very helpful with moving houses, selling cars, and adding cars. They really make everything seamless with minimal effort on our part! We love working with them and wouldn’t look for insurance anywhere else.
reviews.response: Thank you so much, Marissa! We’re so glad to hear that. It’s always a pleasure working with you and helping make those transitions—homes, cars, and all—go as smoothly as possible. We truly appreciate your trust and loyalty!

reviews.author: Kim F
reviews.text: Bret and his staff have provided us with excellent services. They are very knowledgeable and helpful with all of our insurance needs. His customers are the main priority and they are very easy to get ahold of. I wouldn’t go to any other agency.
reviews.response: Thank you so much for your thoughtful review! We’re thrilled to hear that you’ve had a great experience with our team. Providing excellent service and making sure our customers are our top priority is what we strive for every day. We truly appreciate your trust in us and look forward to continuing to serve your insurance needs!

reviews.author: Trudie Boss
reviews.text: Bret took care of my home owners insurance so fast and gave me the best rate. I highly recommend him for any insurance needs.
reviews.response: Thank you, Trudie! I really appreciate the kind words and your trust in letting us help with your homeowners coverage. We’re always glad to find the best rate and make the process quick and easy!

reviews.author: Jacob Allen
reviews.text: I’ve been using Ballentine Farmers for several years now. Brett and Pete have always been very responsive and do everything they can to make sure I have the coverage I need at the best possible price. It’s reassuring having them in my corner. You can deal with these guys in full confidence.
reviews.response: Thank you for your loyalty and for sharing your experience! We’re so glad to hear that Pete and I have been able to provide you with responsive service and the best coverage at the best price. Knowing you feel confident with us in your corner means the world. We truly appreciate your trust and look forward to continuing to serve you!

reviews.author: K T Cruise
reviews.text: Great Customer Service. Explained every item on the policies.

reviews.author: Justin Williams
reviews.text: Pete Carroll at the Ballentine agency has taken tremendous care of us for years, both individually and for our business. His general disposition has always been one of finding a way to be of service with an attitude of knowing there’s a solution that will work for us. Further, it is clear that his integrity is good. In an industry where this isn’t always the case, it’s even more appreciated. I can’t recommend Pete or the Ballentine agency enough.
reviews.response: Thank you for your thoughtful and kind review! We’re so grateful for your trust in Pete and the Ballentine Agency over the years. It means a lot to hear that his dedication, integrity, and commitment to finding the best solutions have made a difference for both your personal and business needs. We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to continuing to serve you!
